newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 3.37 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 3.37 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 3.366 million lbs of pork products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
The latest award under Announcement LS-50, Invitation 03, will be shipped between October 13 and 26, 1996.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced:
Winning bidder for the pork rib-shaped patties was Don Lee Farms (Inglewood CO) 158,400 lbs.
Winning bidders for the 3-ounce pork sausage patties were Cherry Meat Packers Inc (Chicago IL) 792,000 lbs and H&H Meat Products Inc (Mercedes TX) 39,600 lbs.
Winning bidder for the 1.5-ounce pork sausage patties was Cherry Meat Packers Inc (Chicago IL) 396,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for the fine ground pork were American Foods Group (Huron SD) 79,200 lbs, Barrios Distributing (Ocala FL) 79,200 lbs, IBP Inc (Storm Lake IA and Columbus Junction IA) 1,821,600 lbs.
